```yaml
name: CI Benchmark Integration

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - trunk
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          brew install libgit2
          cargo install cargo-benchcmp

      - name: Run benchmarks
        id: benchmarks
        run: |
          ./bench.sh
          echo "results=$(cat bench_results.json)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Setup Git
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config --global user.email 'github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'

      - name: Create perf branch if needed
        run: |
          git checkout -B perf || true

      - name: Push benchmark results
        run: |
          echo "${{ steps.benchmarks.outputs.results }}" > bench_results.json
          git add bench_results.json
          git commit -m "Update benchmark results" || true
          git push origin perf --force-with-lease

      - name: Add step summary
        run: |
          echo "# Benchmark Results" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "```json" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          cat bench_results.json >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "```" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
```
